messages:
release-coord: Kicking hotpatch v2.1.3-hotfix into a staged rollout. Starting canary at 10% now. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Please call stop/go within 15m. Deploy logs below from deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollout:start service=redwood-inference version=v2.1.3-hotfix target_canary=10% cohort=canary-2026-03-23
```
deploy id: rb-deploy-20260323-0912
started: 2026-03-23T09:12:05Z
targets: canary=10% (region: eu-west-1)
steps: warmup -> traffic-shift
```
sophia: observed. I'll watch SLOs and trace errors. ping me if 5xx > 0.5% or latency > 250ms.
chiang: quick note — model tokenizer tweak in this hotpatch changed whitespace handling on edge cases. I ran a small eval: ~0.6% output-format diffs on dev prompts, expected but should be benign. Still watching quality metrics.
raj: infra: kv-cache warmed to ~80% but eviction rate spiked briefly during warmup (see infra logs). Nothing major yet.
maria: quick QA smoke: ran canonical prompt set against canary. 2 failures (formatting) — screenshots uploaded to /mnt/qa/artifacts/2771. Marking as INFO for now.
deploy-bot: [METRICS SNAPSHOT] window=5m canary=10% rps=520 median_latency=118ms p95=420ms 5xx_rate=1.2% (baseline=0.2%) error_breakdown=502:70%,503:30%
qa-bot: auto-eval: regressions=2/250 (0.8%) — regression set flagged: tokenizer-whitespace. severity=minor.
sophia: 5xx at 1.2% is above our stop threshold. Recommend pause and pin traffic back to stable.
chiang: agree with pause. The 5xxs look concentrated on long-seq requests hitting memory-backed tokenizer path. If we let it run, we risk user-facing 502s.
release-coord: vote: pause and pin? react with :thumbsup: for pause, :thumbsdown: to proceed. (call window: 5m)
raj: :thumbsup: — will prepare rollback playbook if needed.
maria: :thumbsup: from QA. upload: logs and diffs linked.
sophia: :thumbsup: holding.
chiang: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollout:pause service=redwood-inference version=v2.1.3-hotfix current_canary=10% reason=5xx-spike
```
rollback_suggestion: pin_traffic_to=0% then rollback_version=v2.1.2-stable
```
release-coord: consensus reached to pause. Pinning v2.1.3-hotfix to 0% and routing back to v2.1.2-stable. I'll update release notes and incident channel.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollback:traffic service=redwood-inference from_version=v2.1.3-hotfix to_version=v2.1.2-stable routed_percent=10% -> 0% completed=100%
```
rollback id: rb-20260323-0914
pinned: v2.1.2-stable
```
sophia: thanks. Can we capture the failing request examples and a snip of the tokenizer stack for the infra/ML teams?
chiang: captured traces and payloads in /var/logs/tracebacks/2771. Will post summary in #eng-ml in 10m.
maria: QA will run expanded regression set against stable to confirm no downstream fallout.
release-coord: I've drafted a short release note addendum: "Hotpatch v2.1.3 rolled to canary, paused due to elevated 5xx from tokenizer edge-case. Traffic pinned back to v2.1.2-stable. Investigating; no customer-facing incident declared yet." Anyone want to tweak wording?
sophia: good. Add: "Action: pin and investigate; rollback if analysis proves risky."
release-coord: updated note and posted to #incidents/ops-briefing. Also scheduling a follow-up postmortem if root cause requires change to rollouts.
deploy-bot: [NOTIFY] change-window: late-night hotpatch paused; rollout state=paused; operator=release-coord
qa-bot: scheduled regression run queued (id=reg-2771). Will post results in thread when complete.
release-coord: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after initial RCA. If someone needs immediate access to the traces ping me or @sophia. :white_check_mark:
